meta.name: SCM Agent golden evaluation dataset
meta.spec_reference: DEVELOPMENT_SPEC_scm_agent.md (Parts D, E, F, H, I, K)
meta.how_to_use: Load each section in tests/golden/ and assert the product output equals expected within tolerance. Any change to an expected value needs owner approval and a DECISIONS.md entry.
clarifications_to_spec: ADI = number of weeks in series / number of weeks with non-zero demand. CV2 = (population std / mean)^2 of non-zero demand sizes.
Supplier trend_flag = last four lead times strictly increasing (three consecutive increases) OR drift_pct >= 0.25.
Risk score rounding is half-up. days_to_stockout of zero-demand items is null and raises no stockout alert.

Number validator v1 supports plain, comma-grouped (Western or Indian), percent and 'percent' formats. Unit words such as lakh or crore are not converted and must fail validation (template fallback is used).
Level 3 downgrades to level 2 when any limit is missing or exceeded, fewer than 30 days were spent in level 1 or 2, or no admin acknowledgment exists.
meta.numbers_note: Expected numeric values were computed with the formulas in the spec using Python standard library math and statistics.NormalDist. Re-verify with an independent implementation before trusting them for customer-facing claims.
